# Zenithh Sports Arena

Hyderabad's premier multi-sport training facility. Elite coaching, world-class infrastructure, and structured athlete performance programs. Built for the next generation of champions.

## Core Information
- **Name**: Zenithh Sports Arena
- **Phone**: +91 79971 71607 / +91 92814 72882
- **Email**: info@zenithh.com
- **Address**: Miyapur Metro Station Road, Miyapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500049.
- **Operating Hours**: Morning: 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM, Evening: 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Subject to seasonal changes)

## Dynamic Sports Profiles
- [Cricket](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/cricket) - Elite cricket coaching with professional net facilities and performance pathways.
- [Pickleball](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/pickleball) - Premium court surfaces for Hyderabad's fastest growing sport.
- [Volleyball](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/volleyball) - Team tactics, serves, spiking, and advanced conditioning.
- [Chess](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/chess) - Cognitive excellence and strategic tournament preparation.
- [Zumba](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/zumba) - Energetic cardiovascular dance fitness.
- [Table Tennis](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/table-tennis) - High-speed rally training and precision reflex loops.
- [Foosball](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/foosball) - Table football competitive strategy.
- [Carrom](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/carrom) - Traditional board sport coaching on competition boards.
- [VR Cricket](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/vr-cricket) - Immersive virtual reality cricket simulator training.
- [Badminton Outdoor](https://www.zenithh.com/sports/badminton-outdoor) - All-weather court play and foundational coaching.
